properties.name: management.endpoint.quartz.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the quartz endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.quartz.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: management.endpoint.quartz.roles
properties.description: Roles used to determine whether a user is authorized to be shown unsanitized job or trigger values. When empty, all authenticated users are authorized.

properties.name: management.endpoint.quartz.show-values
properties.description: When to show unsanitized job or trigger values.

properties.name: spring.quartz.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether to automatically start the scheduler after initialization.

properties.name: spring.quartz.jdbc.comment-prefix
properties.description: Prefixes for single-line comments in SQL initialization scripts.

properties.name: spring.quartz.jdbc.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether initialization should continue when an error occurs when applying a schema script.

properties.name: spring.quartz.jdbc.platform
properties.description: Platform to use in initialization scripts if the @@platform@@ placeholder is used. Auto-detected by default.

properties.name: spring.quartz.jdbc.schema
properties.description: Path to the SQL file to use to initialize the database schema.

properties.name: spring.quartz.overwrite-existing-jobs
properties.description: Whether configured jobs should overwrite existing job definitions.

properties.name: spring.quartz.startup-delay
properties.description: Delay after which the scheduler is started once initialization completes. Setting this property makes sense if no jobs should be run before the entire application has started up.

properties.name: spring.quartz.wait-for-jobs-to-complete-on-shutdown
properties.description: Whether to wait for running jobs to complete on shutdown.
